answer: A payout is split so that 32% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The onyx schedule is applied in pigment and lantern exposes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 758 identities would post 763 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
